description: This header file declares functions related to setting options in the cURL library, such as string options and blob options, and a variadic function for setting multiple options.

methods.name: Curl_setstropt
methods.description: Sets a string option for cURL.

methods.name: Curl_setblobopt
methods.description: Sets a blob option for cURL.

methods.name: Curl_vsetopt
methods.description: Sets multiple options for cURL using a variable argument list.
